content.comment_body: Hello, I am currently using a [product_name] system for a test setup in a process skid. I have PT100 sensors with a range of -50 to 150°C available. Is it possible to read these sensors using the [product_name] module? The range of my sensors is smaller than the standard range (-50 to 200°C) given by the [product_name] module. Can I still read the temperature accurately?

The PT sensor itself does not have a defined temperature range; the limits are determined by the surrounding material and the cable. You can use the PT sensor and also operate within the (-50 to 200°C) range specified for the [product_name] module.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are asking about compatibility between PT100 sensors and the [product_name] module, specifically regarding a sensor's operational range that is narrower than the module's specified range. They want confirmation that the module will perform reliably and accurately in practical applications with this configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that the [product_name] module will be able to read PT100 sensors whose temperature range is narrower than the module's maximum range, without compromising accuracy or functionality.
